title: App submissions can complete Quests
summary:
App submissions can now earn Quest rewards, while Enter’s mobile layouts, Pollen purchase flow, and model browsing got a careful pass.

App submissions can now name an open Quest issue. Once an app is approved, its catalog PR closes the Quest and lets the submitter claim the reward. The dashboard’s Quest badge now prioritizes claimable rewards, then available Quests. Two community image apps also joined the catalog.

The dashboard and shared UI moved to flatter surfaces and tighter mobile layouts. Pollen purchases now show the fee-inclusive total on the Buy button, full-screen phone dialogs use the viewport, and the models page includes official models without recent health data by default. Community publisher filtering was corrected, too.

A declined auto top-up now turns auto top-up off and explains what happened, without interrupting pending authentication or a later re-enable. MiniMax H3 Max Turbo pricing was updated to its promotional rates and weighted billable units; Lyria 3.5 now displays its price per generated song.

daily.title: Apps can complete Quests
daily.text: Add an open Quest issue number when submitting an app. If the app is approved, you can claim the Quest’s Pollen reward. [Read the contributor guide](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).

daily.title: A roomier Enter dashboard
daily.text: Enter’s flatter layout gives dashboard sections and phone screens more usable space. Pollen purchases now put the fee-inclusive total directly on the Buy button.
